items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new spend, production work, experiments, and monetization claims this cycle. Revenue support is insufficient: Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21 and reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0; the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned to any site, so revenue, ROI, forecast, and causal-lift claims are unsupported. Contribution margin is not calculable because site-attributed revenue is absent and infrastructure, fixed, marketing, and implementation costs are not supplied. AI spend is measurable at $995.6313878 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30, but a conflicting prior CFO record reports $988.9074759 for the same window; reconcile before using AI cost in a margin or cost-to-learn denominator. Analytics coverage is 0 of 38 expected sites, so missing traffic and conversions must remain unknown, not zero. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only as a slot-gated candidate after the saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case releases capacity; its 2026-09-21 baseline is 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Minimum finance measurement: one reconciled period ledger tying each site/content identifier to affiliate clicks, ordered and shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure cost, implementation cost, and measurement window. Infrastructure and fixed-cost figures require an authorized billing or owner-supplied cost export; CFO must not access banking or billing directly.

Finance pushback: do not treat 6,219 affiliate clicks, 28 ordered items, shipped items, impressions, sessions, conversions, proposal counts, or social-account counts as revenue or profitability evidence. The provider aggregate row is explicitly unattributed, analytics is unavailable for all 38 expected sites, and no infrastructure, fixed-cost, or marketing-budget figures are present. Named-site margin figures that subtract only AI cost are partial operating-cost views, not contribution margin.

Revenue and profitability claims remain unsupported. Available Amazon evidence is aggregate and unattributed; analytics coverage is unavailable for the expected sites. Do not use clicks, orders, impressions, sessions, AI cost, or social counts as revenue or margin evidence.
